observations: Two rate popup selections failed because the transient menu was dismissed between tool calls; both UI refresh and same-call observed-index selection were used before the final admitted32k record.
A helper parsed a differential AX menu with a full-tree-only index pattern and rejected it without sending an action; full AX reads corrected the helper usage.
An undefined UI snapshot variable prevented one action and a numeric setValue parameter was rejected; both were retried using fresh AX state and the documented string signature.

The first16k-open record is the save-changes prompt for the disposable32k project. Pan was already restored by Undo; Discard Changes was selected and16k-open-confirmed records the loaded16k project. No package Save was performed.
The media mutation control changed only the final byte in the disposable32k attached PCM file. Its exact original bytes were restored before subsequent playback and package integrity verification.
scope: UI setup failures and corrections are retained separately from successful behavior assertions.
